caption:
Need just a few pages from a big PDF? ✂️ Split it into separate files, right on your phone.

1. Open pdf.315tools.com and tap Split PDF
2. Pick your PDF
3. Type the pages, like 1, 2~4, 5~6 (each comma = a new file)
4. Tap Split and save

Free · No sign-up · Your files never leave your device 🔒
